resources.string: A little more present. Every lecture remembered.
Press Record. You can add a course afterwards.
Organise lectures your way. Tap a course to open it; hold to rename.
Text will be highlighted when this moment is transcribed.
Recording comes first. Transcription starts after you stop, to save battery and keep audio safe.
Recording your lecture · tap to open
Tap a passage to listen. Hold it to correct the text.
This text could not be copied. Use Export TXT to save it as a file.
Delete this lecture and its stored audio and transcript? Original imported files stay untouched.
This audio is no longer available. The transcript is still saved.
Applies to new recordings. Audio is kept after errors or cancellation. Deleted audio cannot be replayed; imported originals are never deleted.
Fully on device. A multilingual speech model is included. No account, internet connection or model training is required.
An offline speech model is included.
Microphone access is needed to record a lecture. You can still import audio without it.
Storage is running low. Audio and saved progress are kept. Free some space before continuing.
The tablet is too warm. Audio and progress are safe. Let it cool down, then continue.
Microphone access was not granted. Check the app permissions in Android settings.
The microphone is unavailable. Close other recording or calling apps and try again.
Microphone access was interrupted. Saved audio is kept.
This audio format could not be decoded. Try WAV, MP3, M4A, AAC, FLAC or OGG.
No words were recognised in one or more sections. Audio is kept so you can listen or retry.
Processing failed. Audio and saved progress are kept. You can retry.
The app was interrupted. Saved sections are kept; an unfinished section may need to be recorded again.
Finish the recording or pause transcription before starting another recording.
There is no transcript to export yet.
Audio and transcripts stay on your tablet until you choose to share or export them.
